# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- During calibration, normalize stored measurements to consistent units (°C and %RH). Serial numbers are stable identifiers. For calibration records, store both foreign keys to current entities and snapshots of entity data at start/end.
- Calibration sampling: never sample during ramp or soak; only sample after the chamber is stable and soak has completed (or user skipped). Sample interval is 15 seconds to allow background updates/ASIC update.
- When implementing coefficient calculations, use the PDF-derived logic for temperature digital offset (TempOffset/TempConv) as reference. TempOffset should be computed as Count/Resistance - TempConv (using appropriate 0°C extrapolated values). TempConv (counts/ohm) is a fixed probe constant stored in RotProbe.TempConversion; do not estimate it from sample data. Solve for PT100 coefficients A/B/C and R0 from measured reference temperature vs resistance data, noting that C is likely 0 since no sub-zero test points are available.
